detail.longDescription:
At long last, my blogging project is ready for general use! Check out the video below, or see the main feature list here. 

https://youtu.be/72ZhY3PY8bg

Features:
-  Create posts in HTML or Markdown. RSS versions of your post are created but you can also override it
- Fully responsive layouts for all screen sizes
- OGP metadata support
- Static files are freely editable and viewable, with rare exceptions
- Subscribe to and read RSS and ATOM feeds on the main page
- Automatic sanitization of remote feed files
- Search for posts by category, title, content, date range, image presence
- Directly accepts certificates for HTTPS connections
- Configurable rate limiting and IP ban lists: also supports IP ranges
- Import + export your data to prevent data loss and for migrations
- Supports RFC 5005: Feed Paging and Archiving for your feed
- Editable layout file which gets applied to all of your posts at once

https://codeberg.org/firecakes/cakelandish

No GenAI was used, sad I have to say that now.
